question: Identify the artist with the highest overall sales of albums (tie broken by alphabetical order) and the artist with the lowest overall sales of albums (tie broken by alphabetical order), then calculate the amount each customer spent specifically on those two artists’ albums. Next, compute the average spending for the customers who purchased from the top-selling artist and the average spending for the customers who purchased from the lowest-selling artist, and finally return the absolute difference between these two averages.
sql:
-- Final answer: absolute difference between the two averages
WITH artist_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        a.ArtistId,
        ar.Name AS ArtistName,
        SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS total_sales
    FROM artists ar
    JOIN albums a ON ar.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
    JOIN tracks t ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
    JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
    GROUP BY a.ArtistId, ar.Name
),
top_artist AS (
    SELECT ArtistId FROM artist_sales
    ORDER BY total_sales DESC, ArtistName ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
lowest_artist AS (
    SELECT ArtistId FROM artist_sales
    ORDER BY total_sales ASC, ArtistName ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
customer_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        inv.CustomerId,
        ar.ArtistId,
        ar.Name AS ArtistName,
        SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS customer_artist_spending
    FROM invoice_items ii
    JOIN invoices inv ON ii.InvoiceId = inv.InvoiceId
    JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
    JOIN albums a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId
    JOIN artists ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
    WHERE ar.ArtistId IN (
        (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist),
        (SELECT ArtistId FROM lowest_artist)
    )
    GROUP BY inv.CustomerId, ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
),
avg_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        ArtistId,
        ArtistName,
        AVG(customer_artist_spending) AS avg_customer_spending
    FROM customer_spending
    GROUP BY ArtistId, ArtistName
)
SELECT 
    ABS(top_avg.avg_customer_spending - low_avg.avg_customer_spending) AS absolute_difference
FROM avg_spending top_avg
JOIN avg_spending low_avg ON top_avg.ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist)
    AND low_avg.ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM lowest_artist)

WITH artist_sales AS (

    FROM artists ar

),

    LIMIT 1
),
customer_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        ii.InvoiceId,
        inv.CustomerId,
        c.FirstName,
        c.LastName,
        ar.Name AS ArtistName,
        ar.ArtistId,
        SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS customer_artist_spending
    FROM invoice_items ii
    JOIN invoices inv ON ii.InvoiceId = inv.InvoiceId
    JOIN customers c ON inv.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
    JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
    JOIN albums a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId

    WHERE ar.ArtistId IN (
        (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist),
